name: Do I need to prime or paint trim before installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to prime or paint trim before installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is possible to prime and paint trim before installation, it often leads to a better and more seamless finish if these steps are completed after the trim is installed. Post-installation priming and painting allow for touch-ups over nail holes and seams, ensuring a continuous, finished look that integrates well with your walls. Maine Results, Inc. typically recommends completing these finishing touches after the trim is secured, allowing for a polished final result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Priming and painting trim are usually best done after installation. This allows for a more seamless finish by addressing nail holes and seams.
